$comment: Single source of per-route metadata. Read at runtime by RouteObserver in src/App.tsx and at build time by scripts/prerender-head.mjs, which bakes these values into one HTML file per route so crawlers and link unfurlers do not depend on JavaScript. Keep every sitemap.xml path represented here — src/__tests__/sitemap.test.ts asserts it.
